// City configuration with coordinates and climate-relative thresholds
const cities = [
  {
    name: 'Tallinn',
    country: 'Estonia',
    lat: 59.4370,
    lon: 24.7536,
    timezone: 'Europe/Tallinn',
    thresholds: {
      // Tallinn: cold baseline. Snow is normal. Alert only on extreme events.
      snowfall_cm_urgent: 20,       // >20cm in 24h = severe disruption
      snowfall_cm_heads_up: 10,     // >10cm = plan ahead
      rain_mm_urgent: 30,           // Heavy rain (unusual for Tallinn)
      rain_mm_heads_up: 15,
      wind_kmh_urgent: 65,          // Storm-force
      wind_kmh_heads_up: 45,
      temp_min_urgent: -20,         // Extreme cold – courier supply risk
      temp_min_heads_up: -15,
      visibility_m_urgent: 200,     // Near-zero visibility
      visibility_m_heads_up: 500
    }
  },
  {
    name: 'Madrid',
    country: 'Spain',
    lat: 40.4168,
    lon: -3.7038,
    timezone: 'Europe/Madrid',
    thresholds: {
      // Madrid: dry baseline. Heat is the primary risk. Snow is exceptional.
      snowfall_cm_urgent: 2,        // ANY snow = disruption (rare)
      snowfall_cm_heads_up: 0.5,
      rain_mm_urgent: 40,           // Intense thunderstorms
      rain_mm_heads_up: 20,
      wind_kmh_urgent: 70,
      wind_kmh_heads_up: 50,
      temp_max_urgent: 40,          // Heatwave – courier health + supply drop
      temp_max_heads_up: 36,
      temp_min_urgent: -5,          // Rare freeze – ice on roads
      temp_min_heads_up: -2
    }
  },
  {
    name: 'Warsaw',
    country: 'Poland',
    lat: 52.2297,
    lon: 21.0122,
    timezone: 'Europe/Warsaw',
    thresholds: {
      // Warsaw: mixed climate. Cold winters + summer storms.
      snowfall_cm_urgent: 15,
      snowfall_cm_heads_up: 7,
      rain_mm_urgent: 35,
      rain_mm_heads_up: 18,
      wind_kmh_urgent: 65,
      wind_kmh_heads_up: 45,
      temp_min_urgent: -18,
      temp_min_heads_up: -12,
      temp_max_urgent: 37,
      temp_max_heads_up: 33
    }
  },
  {
    name: 'Lagos',
    country: 'Nigeria',
    lat: 6.5244,
    lon: 3.3792,
    timezone: 'Africa/Lagos',
    thresholds: {
      // Lagos: tropical baseline. Heavy rain + flooding are primary risks.
      // Snow threshold intentionally extreme – any snow = unprecedented alert.
      snowfall_cm_urgent: 0.1,      // ANY snow = extraordinary event
      snowfall_cm_heads_up: 0.1,
      rain_mm_urgent: 60,           // Flooding risk threshold
      rain_mm_heads_up: 35,         // Heavy tropical rain
      wind_kmh_urgent: 55,          // Tropical storm
      wind_kmh_heads_up: 40,
      temp_max_urgent: 42,          // Extreme heat – unusual even for Lagos
      temp_max_heads_up: 38,
      humidity_pct_urgent: 95,      // Extreme humidity compounds heat risk
      humidity_pct_heads_up: 88
    }
  }
];

return cities.map(city => ({ json: city }));
